what: supplement 8 to the night-1 pre-registration: arm P*, the answer model given the reranked top 10 of Vol.4's exact search over the whole HotpotQA corpus instead of the Blueprint's approximate top 100
why: arm P (0.534) lost to arm O (0.728) partly in retrieval: the default index keeps both supporting passages among the ten for 4,271 of 7,405 questions. P* puts exact search in its place and changes nothing else, so the difference P* - P is the cost of the approximate index to the answer, and O - P* what reranking and ten passages leave
status_in_the_comparison: a reference beside the tuned versions, not one of them: exact search, nothing tuned

arm.retrieve: Vol.4's exact search, top 100 per question, every passage of HotpotQA (nDCG@10 0.801): the run file below
arm.rerank: scripts/p_arm.py rerank, unchanged from arm P: the 100 passages in retrieval order in the Blueprint's batches of 32, 32, 32, 4, all logits together, the first 10
arm.answer: scripts/answer_arms.py run with arm O's request body and the ten passages in reranked order (p_arm.py ids): every field as arm P; only the passages differ
arm.answer_model: Nemotron 3 Nano at the NIM's defaults, no reasoning parser, as arm P on night 3

passage_texts.made_by: p_arm.py texts on the run above (CPU, 2026-10-22)

measures.arm: contains the official answer (rate, Wilson 95%), F1, EM, refusals by pattern, finish reasons
measures.paired: P* against P and P* against O on the same 7,405 questions, exact McNemar
measures.passages: both / one / none of the two supporting passages among P*'s ten; questions whose ten equal P's

seen_before_this_supplement.note: known when the interval was set, all without generating an answer; the counts for P* come from Vol.4's reranked run (one call of 100 per question), not from the batches this arm uses
seen_before_this_supplement.projection: P's rates by supporting-passage count applied to P*'s counts: 0.632

expect.why: the projection is 0.632; the band allows the other eight passages to change answers either way
expect.P_star_vs_P: P* right and P wrong outnumbers the reverse, exact McNemar p < 0.001
expect.P_star_vs_O: O stays higher, exact McNemar p < 0.001
expect.outside_the_band: reported as it is, with the passage counts; no rerun

branches.a_question_fails: retried by answer_arms.py as on night 3; a question still failing counts as not containing the answer
branches.not_done_by_the_stop_time: the answers written so far stay; the run resumes on another night the owner gives; nothing is scored before all 7,405 are in

stop: 08:00 of the night the owner gives, unless the owner names another end
per_question_table: after scoring, one line per question (query_id, contains, f1, refusal, the ten passage ids; no answer text) for the external evaluation, kept outside the repository
